title: Kamal (pilgrim, Tanavu, Onesa)
description: Persona: a 61-year-old from Tanavu going on pilgrimage for the first time. He has type 2 diabetes and high blood pressure, takes insulin and two tablets a day, is allergic to penicillin, and carries one phone. Fictional.

persona.name: Kamal
persona.goal: Make the pilgrimage safely, and be treated properly if he is taken ill far from home.
needs: Health workers abroad who know about his insulin and his penicillin allergy
To decide who sees his summary, and for how long
Something that works from the one phone he carries
frustrations: Explaining his medicines in a language the clinic does not speak
Paper records that get lost or left behind
